description: She wears an ivory patterned floor-length gown with a low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Burgundy-and-gold woven borders decorate the neckline, bodice, cuffs and hem. Small round shoulder brooches, a narrow jeweled belt and a pendant add ornament. A burgundy mantle with gold edging hangs loosely around her forearms. Gold closed shoes are visible through the low skirt opening; her head is bare.
